versions.changelog: v1.0.2: Fix video analysis ARG_MAX bug, fix image editing local files (temp upload), fix models.sh listing. Add ClawhHub metadata with runtime requirements (env: POLLINATIONS_API_KEY, bins: curl/jq/base64).

- Added new utility scripts: analyze-image.sh (image analysis), analyze-video.sh (video analysis), image-edit.sh (image-to-image editing), models.sh (list models), and transcribe.sh (audio transcription).
- Expanded documentation with detailed usage and options for each new script.
- Improved coverage for content analysis and AI-powered transformations (images, video, and audio).
- Users can now analyze, transcribe, and edit content from the command line with dedicated scripts.
Initial release - AI generation for text, images, videos, audio with 25+ models
